route_a_gate_compliance_summary.data_limitation_note: onchain_events.db records curve creations and migrations but contains no individual trading order flow (buys/sells). Consequently, '0 tokens have >= 25 distinct buyers' is true solely by construction of the dataset, and top-holder concentration cannot be derived from creation events alone. Deriving realistic post-creation curve distributions requires live trade collection via CurveTradeCollector.
